name: jcouball
description: James Couball's agent plugins: cross-repo skills and commands for writing, explaining, and maintaining Ruby open source projects.

plugins.name: jcouball-writing
plugins.description: Writing and explanation tools. Strips AI tells from prose while keeping reference docs dry, and explains technical subjects in plain language without dropping the real terms.

plugins.name: jcouball-github
plugins.description: GitHub pull request workflow tools. Resolves PR review feedback and suppressed Copilot comments, folds fixes into the commits that introduced them, requests fresh Copilot reviews, and rebases a branch onto the default branch without opening an editor.

plugins.name: jcouball-marketplace
plugins.description: Commands for maintaining the jcouball marketplace itself: promote a full project skill into the marketplace, or add a thin project-local override file for a skill that already lives there.
